still_usable_note: Twilio says the Authy API is closed to new customers; qualifying existing TOTP/Push customers remain supported until End of Life, which is not assigned an exact date in the reviewed documentation.
summary: Twilio Authy API is closed to new customers and planned for future full deprecation. Existing qualifying customers remain supported for now, with Twilio Verify v2 recommended for new development.
current_state: Limited to eligible existing customers; no exact End-of-Life date is asserted by the current reviewed Twilio documentation.
known_unknowns: Twilio's reviewed documentation does not provide an exact full-deprecation or End-of-Life date.
notes: Corrects the older display state that implied a dated upcoming shutdown.
